Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: a new cinematic illustrated hero bitmap for Twisted Pin's Jingle Bowl campaign, portrait 4:5, very high resolution.

Image 2 (released Jingle Bowl square poster) is a campaign-identity, facial-character, and illustration-finish reference only. Do not reproduce either image's existing typography or layout.
Primary request: create an epic, sophisticated Christmas poster image centered on this same charismatic, warmly mischievous Santa, carrying a glossy deep-evergreen bowling ball with exactly three finger holes. Santa is the unmistakable visual hero, looking toward the viewer with the same open, delighted expression and luxuriant beard as the approved character. Preserve his recognizable facial styling, red velvet coat and hat, cream fur, and black leather/gold buckle details; new composition and natural carrying pose are welcome.
Scene/backdrop: a fictional theatrical Christmas tableau, NOT a real venue photograph: rich dark evergreen and almost-black indigo depth, a few lush evergreen branches framing the middle edges, two or three beautifully wrapped cranberry/evergreen gifts with subtle champagne-gold satin ribbon near Santa's lower silhouette, softly glowing warm holiday lights receding into atmospheric shadow. A small number of tasteful glass ornaments add depth. This is editorial fantasy illustration, not a depiction of Twisted Pin's actual room or an offer of gifts.
Composition/framing: purpose-composed vertical 4:5 artwork. Keep the top approximately 20% and bottom approximately 20% quiet, near-black dark evergreen/indigo atmospheric negative space so the designer can add editable headline and date/CTA later. The central 60% contains the large Santa portrait and bowling ball; Santa's face near 36% canvas height and ball near 61%. Frame him roughly mid-thigh upward, with strong sculptural silhouette, depth and layered foreground/background. Keep his face, hat, hands and ball entirely inside the image, never cropped. The bottom dark field must not be filled with objects or ornaments. No flat hard-edged blank bands: negative space should blend seamlessly into the atmospheric scene.
Style/medium: exceptionally art-directed, cinematic premium Christmas illustration, painterly realism with dimensional light, exquisite beard/fur detail, tactile velvet and reflective green ball. Same sophisticated illustration family as the references, with stronger depth and materials. Warm inviting human expression; confident, playful and adult-quality. It must feel striking at phone-thumbnail size without becoming cluttered.
Lighting/mood: rich directional warm gold key light and restrained evergreen rim light. Deep shadows, warm light behind shoulders, subtle luminous dust/bokeh; not neon. Preserve fine texture rather than an airbrushed plastic face.
Color palette: deep evergreen, near-black indigo, rich cranberry red, warm ivory and restrained champagne gold.
Text: NONE. No lettering, numbers, logo, brand mark, date, watermark, labels or borders.
Constraints: single Santa, no guests, no children, no crowd, no lanes or identifiable venue interiors, no pizza/cocoa imagery, no implication of Santa bowling with guests. He carries the ball as an ornament-like hero object, not throwing or bowling. No additional promises or offers. No generic clipart, cartoons, grinning plastic 3D, collage, busy snowstorm, neon saturation or excessive props.
